# Turncoats
[color=#999999][italic]...is a all about making sure your allies are actually your allies. You know what they say, keep your friends close...[/italic][/color]
Antagonists: [color=#ff0000]Traitors[/color] and [color=yellowgreen]Parasites[/color]
Key Identities: [color=gray]Subverter[/color] and [color=gold]VIP[/color]
## Summary
Subverters have the ability to turn any incapacitated (but alive) person into a traitor. Between them and the Parasites about, anyone could be a friend or enemy and you can never be sure who.
Crew gets many roles that can confirm themselves to some degree, VIP, Pickpocket, and Arms Dealers to name a few. But can you really trust that confirmation?
There's fewer traitors at round start than other masquerades, so converting someone to your team can be a life changer to make up for this initial numbers disadvantage. It's up to you whether you want an ally quickly or whether to try play your cards into a high value target, such as the Captain or a very well trusted member of the crew.
As a parasite, do what you think you can. There's less blood-hungry identities, and you can be converted into a traitor just like anyone else. Play it smart or hope for a good snowballing set of infections.
